newsitem.title: USA: Hilton seeks land Mirage eying - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Hilton seeks land Mirage eying - WSJ.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Inc is looking to buy a parcel of land in Atlantic City, N.J. where Mirage Resorts Inc and two other casinos are planning a $2 billion project, the Wall Street Journal said in Friday's electronic edition.
The 150 acres are already the subject of a dispute between Mirage and developer Donald Trump.
The president of Hilton's gaming operations, Arthur Goldberg, wrote Atlantic City mayor James Whelan offering to buy the land, formerly a garbage dump site, the paper said.
Goldberg did not name a price but offered not to take an incentive package the city was offering Mirage, it said.
The package included building a $330 million tunnel, road improvements, free land and reimbursement for environmental cleanup. Trump has already sued Atlantic City for agreeing to build the tunnel.
